feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 July 2026 4:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 23 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest, 4 or 5 in most waters, but occasionally increasing 6 to the west of the Isle of Man. Then decreasing variable 2 or 3 by the afternoon in the southwest of the area towards Dublin Bay, before becoming 3 or 4 in most waters later in the evening, then backing westerly overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West, backing southwest for a time, 3 or 4, occasionally increasing 5 in the evening, then becoming 4 or 5 at the end of the night.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then a risk of light rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any light rain.
